arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nintedanib%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pirfenidone%') ORDER BY concept_name

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Condition' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diarrhea%') AND standard_concept='S' ORDER BY concept_name

    AND EXISTS (

), diarrhea_desc AS (

    UNION SELECT 196523
), events AS (

        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement m

              AND co.condition_start_date > iu.index_date
